fact_previews: The Park Project is a mobile app designed to find real-time available parking spots.
The app utilizes community and crowdsharing for its functionality.
The project was created by an individual named Aryan.
The project was launched on Kickstarter with a funding goal of $6,214.
The funding period for the project was from June 23, 2025, to August 2, 2025.

fact_previews: The app is called Park Project.
Park Project offers real-time open spot sharing.
The app includes a map and list view of available parking spots, including garages, private, and street options.
Park Project features a reward system called Park Coins to encourage community participation.
The app has beta integrations with CarPlay, Android Auto, and Wear OS.
